Hiring a heating and air conditioning company can be a stressful experience. Trust in the experts at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air. We specialize in all aspects of San Antonio, TX heating and air conditioning services, and take the stress and discomfort associated with repairs and maintenance. With over a decade of service to our customers in and around San Antonio, TX, we can confidently say we are the best. From AC repairs, to furnace maintenance, our expert staff will be able to provide you with work that is done right the first time we arrive. We won’t try to sell you on things you don’t need, but rather get the job done in a timely and professional manner. Read our customer reviews below, and call us to schedule an appointment for your heating and air conditioning needs today!
More testimonials!

We recently contracted with your company for the installation of a new HVAC unit. The “J-Team” you sent to take care of us (Joe, Jason and Joseph) were just fantastic. Joe explained everything in detail to both of us, meeting with me first and sending a detailed email with bid after that visit. He took his time explaining things again to my husband on his second trip here. We accepted the bid while he was here and the installation was scheduled for two days later. When Jason and Joseph showed up to install it they knew exactly what to do. There were several changes that needed to be made inside the closet the unit is in and they knew about all of them and explained what they did to bring things up to code. They worked 11 hours and if it hadn’t been for a glitch in our main breaker box we’d have been up and running the same day. They recommended that we call Hill Electric and they came the next day and fixed the problem. Jason and Joseph showed up that same afternoon and got the AC going for us. They explained the thermoset features to us and it works great. It is so quiet we don’t even hear it running. Inside or outside. The whole experience was very pleasant for us and I thank you for that. The price was competitive and workmanship and customer service from the “J-team” was exceptional. We’ll be calling you in the fall to replace our upstairs unit.
-Gayle L
We are thrilled with your services. Thank you. We have recommended you to anyone who asks about our HVAC.
-Kelly M

Rosenberg is an amazing company! They have done the twice a year checks on my HVAC system for 2 years now…when I first bought my home. From the first visit, Trey was amazing! He is extremely thorough in his work, and so kind when he explains what he is doing, or what he finds so that I can understand the situation. A favorite aspect of their service, is that I get Trey, in other words the SAME serviceman, each visit. He is familiar with my system, and me, and treats me like a family member each time. All of the office staff, those who book the appointments, and make the calls to tell us when service is due to arrive are the nicest ladies ever! I think anyone looking for HVAC service should consider using Rosenberg…they will never get any better service or performance from anyone else…I just don’t believe that would be possible! Thanks, ya’ll!!!
-Catherine T
